from scipy.optimize import least_squares
var=np.var(dv_dt)
def model(q):
    A,k,w,c0,cc,ss,cv,cxv,cv2=q
    return A*x*np.exp(-k*x)+c0+cc*np.cos(w*t)+ss*np.sin(w*t)+cv*v+cxv*x*v+cv2*v*v
s=least_squares(lambda q: model(q)-dv_dt, [27.7,0.72,0.131,-7.9,8.0,-2.0,0,0,0],max_nfev=5000,xtol=1e-15,ftol=1e-15,gtol=1e-15)
print("NMSE",np.mean(s.fun**2)/var, np.round(s.x,6))
# alternative: x-part with x^2 exp term and v
def model2(q):
    A,k,w,c0,cc,ss,cv,cx2,cv2=q
    return A*x*np.exp(-k*x)+c0+cc*np.cos(w*t)+ss*np.sin(w*t)+cv*v+cx2*x*x+cv2*np.abs(v)*v
s2=least_squares(lambda q: model2(q)-dv_dt, [27.7,0.72,0.131,-7.9,8.0,-2.0,0,0,0],max_nfev=5000,xtol=1e-15,ftol=1e-15,gtol=1e-15)
print("NMSE2",np.mean(s2.fun**2)/var, np.round(s2.x,6))

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    g = x*np.exp(-params[5]*x)
    c = np.cos(params[2]*t)
    s = np.sin(params[2]*t)
    return params[0] + params[1]*c + params[3]*s + params[4]*g + params[6]*g*c + params[7]*g*s
